axis_supply.supply_status: Poor. CC.NN. divisions received lowest priority for supplies compared to regular Army divisions. Division surrounded at Bardia from 1 December 1940, isolated from main supply lines. Water shortage critical in static defensive positions.

allied_supply.supply_status: Well-supplied during Operation Compass preparation (October-November 1940). Division had priority for fuel/ammunition as assault formation. Water supply critical - dedicated water truck convoys. Captured Italian rations supplemented British stocks after Nibeiwa/Tummar. Division withdrawal on 11 December relieved supply strain but demonstrated logistical constraints on sustained desert operations.
